# UC-LEARN14 — CIBA human approval — PingFederate or PingOne, by how you signed in

**Track:** learn  
**Maturity:** ✅ `works`  


## Buyer Story

An AI agent needs a real person to approve a sensitive action on their own device, and the organisation may run its authorization server on PingFederate or on PingOne.

## PingOne Solution

The page asks the authorization server that issued your session. Signed in through PingFederate, it starts a PingFederate CIBA request and a mock phone pops up to approve it. Signed in through PingOne, it starts PingOne CIBA and the approval goes to your enrolled PingOne MFA device. Either way the page polls until the request is approved, denied or expired.

## How to Run

**Trigger:** Trigger (link): `{"type":"link","path":"/pingfederate-ai-agent","label":"Open the CIBA approval demo"}`  
**Expected outcome:** `GUIDED_LEARNING`

## What to Say

> Sign in through PingFederate and ask for approval: PingFederate runs CIBA and the mock phone pops up. Sign in through PingOne and ask again: PingOne runs CIBA and the prompt goes to the MFA device. The page says which one answered.
